title: UCP Extension in Dimension Three
summary: We show that every UCP extension problem for a finite dimensional operator system can be reduced to three dimensions after finite matrix amplification. The set of extensions is preserved by an affine bijection. The matrix size is of order $\sqrt{d}$, where $d$ is the dimension of the original system. This also gives a three dimensional (smallest) counterexample to Arveson's hyperrigidity conjecture.
